economic_hypothesis: A new industry main line is a synchronized capital-allocation event, not a single-stock pattern. In a causal broad BULL state, the first day in ten sessions with at least two limit-up closes, industry median daily return >=1%, and >=70% positive members is an industry ignition. Upper-location, turnover-backed cohort members express leader or follower participation.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open

industry_ignition.freshness: no ignition in preceding10 completed industry sessions

market.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

rules.R1_LIMIT_LEADER: stock closes at its applicable price limit
rules.R4_THREE_PCT_LOW_EXTENSION_FOLLOWER: not limit-up, daily return>=3%, and pre-signal ret20<=15%

stock_acceptance: close>=open; close location>=70%; turnover>=1.5x preceding20 mean; pre-signal ret20<=30%
